replies.author: awesome_apricot
replies.body:
In what way? 
Its a CTW map designed for the tournament. The back island is the wool room. 
The spawn point is at the top in the middle - you fall down to spawn in.
There is Iron supplies to the left and right.
There is two diamond blocks for defences - along with all other defence supplies.
The front lines are sloped and equipped with an archer tower. 
The map, as a whole, is designed to be:
Hard and to solo push - we want teamwork 
Hard to defend - the void areas on the back will be able to contain blocks 
Hard to skybridge - Archer tower and the high areas Make any skybridging hard 
The aim is to see players running back with wool accross the main belt of the map. 
There is anti tunnel walls around..
Any questions?
